headline: Last session: Sensex, Nifty close at eight-month highs; markets closed today for Diwali-Balipratipada holiday.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: Indian equity markets are closed today, November 10, for the Diwali-Balipratipada holiday.
In the last session, Sensex and Nifty extended gains to close at their highest levels in over eight months.
Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) turned net buyers, pouring Rs 53,739 crore into D-Street in November so far.
India VIX jumped 68% over three weeks despite a 7% rally in Sensex and Nifty.
whatHappening: NSE and BSE remain shut for equity trading today and will resume normal operations tomorrow.
Bajaj Finance issued 5.74 crore warrants to its promoter for Rs 5,799 crore.
MRF implemented price hikes and cost-cutting measures to counter raw material shocks and logistics squeezes.
MCX is scheduled to resume trading in the evening session after remaining closed during the morning.
summary: Indian benchmark indices closed at eight-month highs in the previous session, boosted by net FPI inflows of Rs 53,739 crore in November. Equity markets are shut today for the Diwali-Balipratipada holiday and will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November. Key corporate developments include Bajaj Finance issuing Rs 5,799 crore warrants to promoters and MRF raising prices to weather cost pressures.
